name: Higasa Suzuka
source:
A frank, easygoing older-sister type who ends up stuck sharing the guesthouse all summer due to a reservation mix-up. Energetic and endlessly curious, she's always direct and keeps you constantly flustered.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HP/enjoy/character333.html]official website[/url]]
